description: The Unit & Integration Tester's tests for the delivered code.

summary.description: What changed and why, in a few sentences.

covers.description: The acceptance criteria the tests check, quoted.

path.description: Relative to the project root, with forward slashes.

content.description: The whole file as it should be written.

files.description: Every file to create or replace.

notes.description: Anything the next worker or the owner must know; empty when there is nothing.

defects.description: Defects in earlier workers' code that your tests expose: the file at fault and what is wrong. Empty when the code is right.

file.description: The file at fault, relative to the project root.

problem.description: What the code does wrong, and what it should do instead.
